bluf: SmartSites is a founder led full service agency in Paramus, NJ, an SMB generalist calling itself America's best rated digital marketer. The record shows it doing something narrower than it advertises: its dated 2025 and 2026 case studies are Klaviyo email programmes and organic social for retailers and practices, while its 584 Google ads sell page one rankings and Premier Partner status. Horus reads it Neutral at 3.1, best placed for KJ8 and most exposed to KJ6; Monsoon puts displacement at 67.0. The one thing a rival should know: it buys its own demand at scale, publishes no pricing, and 7 of its 20 named clients are names only.
doing:

The sold mix has no lead line; five lines sit at score 2: Creator & Influencer (a Social Media case category, Essential Electric Supply the example), Email & CRM (28 Email & SMS case studies, Klaviyo revenue wins for SōKO and Filamatrix), Paid Search (a PPC case category, 584 own Google ads, Google Premier Partner status claimed in its ads), SEO (an Organic SEO case category, ads pitching page one rankings) and Web & Product (JSON-LD describing a web design and development agency). Data & Measurement, Local, Programmatic, Retail Media and AI Automation score 0. The family read puts Creator & social at 2.3 and Data & measurement at 0. The record lists no proprietary product and one partner, the Google Premier Partner status claimed in its own ads.

Recent moves: the record lists none and no news. The dated activity is publishing: case studies dated 2025-08-21 (Essential Electric Supply, Sprayer Depot, Elit Tile) through 2026-08-24 (Car Time Supercenter), four social studies on 2026-02-03, and blog posts dated 2026-09-21 to 2026-09-29.

The record lists no pricing model. Conspicuously absent: a founding year, an employee count, jobs or an ATS (jobs count 0), any data and measurement line, and any AI service page from an agency whose co-founder writes the AI search chapter.

openings:
The strongest opening is price: displacement 67.0 on the Monsoon read, no public pricing (P5 unknown) and SEO and web hours an offshore delivered rival can undercut line by line. It is likely, moderate confidence, that a transparent outcome priced SEO and PPC offer beats it on the accounts it advertises hardest for. Falsifier: a published price list on smartsites.com, or a Radar compile listing a delivery hub.

The gap to lead with is the distance between what it advertises and what it proves: 584 Google ads sell page one rankings and Premier Partner status, but the dated 2025 and 2026 case studies are Klaviyo email and organic social, Data & Measurement scores 0 and P4 is partial. A rival that shows SEO and PPC results with measurement depth very likely wins the search conversation. P8 and P2 are absent: the first agency in its segment to show results from ads inside AI assistants sets the price, and feed, schema and entity work for its ecommerce retailers is unclaimed (likely, low confidence).

The contestable names: the 7 names only carry no described work, and KJ6 removes the paid search and SEO hours the sold mix leans on.
